name: Subtitle Downloader
description: Clean, conflict-free in-player subtitle search and download with 64-bit video hash sync matching, UTF-8 normalization, and multi-source downloading (OpenSubtitles, SubDL, and Jellyfin).
overview: Adds an in-player subtitle downloader that saves subtitles directly beside your media files, seamlessly refreshes playback, and displays subtitles in Jellyfin's native CC menu without any overlay conflicts.

versions.changelog: Simplified, conflict-free in-player subtitle downloader: 64-bit movie hash sync, multi-provider support (OpenSubtitles REST API v2, SubDL, Jellyfin native), UTF-8 charset normalization, automatic player refresh to display subtitles directly in Jellyfin's standard subtitle menu.
